title: Stage 5 screw connections
suptitle: R_hip_pitch_to_roll_roll_flip (yellow Stage 5, pitch link): land on the ST3025 wheel face, arms on the measured roll horn / idler faces with a 0.10 mm running fit, rear top corner chamfered clear of the back shell; rear arm slotted for the case's stub, 3 idler screws (owner 2026-11-22)

sections.title: SECTION A-A at y 2 (pitch axis, wheel screws 1 / 4), seen from -y
SECTION B-B at z 184 (stub insertion slot, below the roll axis), seen from +z

body:
mass 11.71 g PAHT-CF + 11 steel sleeves 4.19 g (was 11.57 g, hub recess r 6.0)
mating faces measured: horn y -12.0, idler y 25.25, wheel x 61.0
screws (stack = L - 0.5 - reference, from the defined holes):
  4 x M3x12 into the ST3025 wheel: engaged 2.935-2.95 of 2.95
  4 x M3x8 horn / 3 x M3x8 idler (owner 2026-11-22: the (56, 183)
    idler screw dropped, its sleeve too): 0.10 mm free gap per side
stub slot (rear arm inner face): the case's rear stub (r 3.0, to
  y 25.80) rises along +z in a slot x 52.8..59.2, floor y 25.95 (0.60
  deep), from the arm's lower edge (lead-in 0.6 per side) into the
  centre hole; servo unit insertion path overlap 0 mm3 (was 7.8 mm3,
  first contact 15.3 mm before the seat)
idler load 6 kg x 1.5 g: 180 N radial, 39 N axial; per screw 60 N / 13 N
rear arm top: 0.8 mm / 35 deg counter-chamfer (was a 57 deg knife edge)
FEM (layer x), min p99 strength ratio: Bambu PAHT-CF 3.33 heavy /
  3.35 roll stall (was 3.41 / 3.43), legacy PETG-CF 2.51 roll stall
  (was 2.50); peak 107 MPa (roll stall) at the front arm root
